description: Wire src/app/(frontend)/EcoCertApp.tsx to live data. Replace all static arrays with server action calls. Add AppContext for user/org state, real auth (login/register/session restore), role-gated UI, per-page CRUD modals, and notification system. Depends on FEAT-001 (collections) and FEAT-002 (actions). The file is 'use client' and already has useMemo + useState imported — add useEffect, useCallback, useTransition, createContext, useContext.
steps: Add to existing imports at top of EcoCertApp.tsx: useEffect, useCallback, useTransition, createContext, useContext from 'react'. Add import of all needed server actions from '@/actions/ecocert'.

Define AppContext just below imports: type AppUser = { id: string; name: string; role: string; email: string; organization?: { id: string; name: string } }. type AppCtx = { currentUser: AppUser | null; organizationId: string | null; setCurrentUser: (u: AppUser | null) => void }. const AppContext = createContext<AppCtx>({ currentUser: null, organizationId: null, setCurrentUser: () => {} }).

Modify Login component: add state for email, password, orgName, nit, sector, name, error, plus useTransition. Wire each input to its state. Replace static onSubmit with startTransition calling loginUser or registerUser. On success call onLogin(result.data). Show inline error when result.success===false. Keep demo note div unchanged.

Modify EcoCertApp default export: add currentUser state and useEffect that calls getCurrentUser() on mount — if found, setCurrentUser and setLoggedIn(true). Pass real user object to Login onLogin callback. Wrap return in AppContext.Provider.

Modify EcoCertShell: read currentUser from AppContext. Replace hardcoded 'María Rodríguez' in sidebar footer with currentUser?.name. Replace role label with a roleLabelMap lookup. Replace 'Buenos días, María' with dynamic greeting. Replace 'EcoVerde S.A.S.' org name with currentUser?.organization?.name when available.

Modify Dashboard: read orgId and userId from AppContext. Add loading state. useEffect fetches getAspects, getObjectives, getNonConformities, getLegalRequirements, getNotifications in parallel with Promise.all. Filter legal requirements for nextReview within 30 days for expiring count. Replace static kpis values with real counts. Show animate-pulse skeleton while loading. Show real unread notification count in bell badge.

Modify TablePage for 'aspectos': add rows state initialized to []. useEffect calls getAspects(orgId) and maps docs to string[][] rows. Add loading skeleton. Role-gate the 'Nuevo aspecto' button: only show if currentUser.role is 'environmental_manager' or 'administrator'.

Extend Modal component for aspectos: existing significance calculation fields already present. Wire submit to createAspect({ organization: orgId, activity, name: aspectName, impact, severity: s, frequency: f, scope: a, createdBy: currentUser?.id }). On success call onClose and trigger a rows refresh via a refreshKey state increment.

Modify TablePage for 'legales': useEffect fetches getLegalRequirements(orgId), maps to rows. After fetch, run expiry check: for each doc check nextReview within 7/15/30 days and call createNotification for each threshold crossed. Extend Modal for 'legales' with fields: title, issuer, aspect (text for now), nextReview (date input), compliance (select), responsible (select from getUsers). Wire submit to createLegalRequirement.

Wire 'objetivos' page: add rows/cards state. useEffect fetches getObjectives(orgId). Map each doc to card props: title, owner name, progress percent, status, target+unit, deadline. Add 'Nuevo objetivo' modal with fields: title, indicator, target (number), unit, deadline (date), owner (user select), status (select), plus dynamic actions array (add/remove rows, each row: description, resources, deadline, responsible user select). RN-05 validation: block submit if actions array is empty or any action missing required field. Wire to createObjective. Role-gate 'Aprobar objetivo' button to senior_management and administrator.

Wire 'auditorias' page: useEffect fetches getAudits(orgId). Map to table rows. Extend Modal for 'auditorias': area, scope, criteria, date, auditor (user select), status (select), plus dynamic findings array (add/remove, fields: description, criteria, criticality select, isNonConformity checkbox, evidenceUrl). Wire submit to createAudit.

Wire 'conformidades' page (NonConformities component): useEffect fetches getNonConformities(orgId). Group by status into kanban columns: Detectada, Escalada, En análisis, En ejecución, En verificación. Replace static cards with real data. Map doc.code, doc.description, doc.criticality to card display.

Wire 'incidentes' page: useEffect fetches getIncidents(orgId). Map to rows. Extend Modal for 'incidentes': type select, description textarea, date, location, severity select, responsePlan textarea, status select. Pre-fill reportedBy with currentUser.id. Wire submit to createIncident.

Wire 'capacitacion' page: useEffect fetches getTrainings(orgId). Map to rows: topic, formatDate(date), attendee name, result%, competent. Extend Modal for 'capacitacion': topic, date, attendee (user select), result (number 0-100), competent select. Wire submit to createTraining.

Wire 'evidencias' page: useEffect fetches getEvidences(orgId). Map to rows. Extend Modal for 'evidencias': description, sourceTable, recordId, statusReview select. File upload via <input type='file'> — note: for Payload upload fields the file must be submitted via FormData to a route handler; for this FEAT, use a simpler approach: create the evidence record without a file and add a TODO comment for file upload wiring, OR implement a /api/upload route handler that accepts FormData and calls payload.create with the file. Choose the route handler approach: create src/app/(frontend)/api/upload/route.ts that accepts POST FormData, extracts the file, calls getPayload, and creates a media document, then calls createEvidence with the returned media id.

Wire 'notificaciones' page: replace static notification list with useEffect calling getNotifications(currentUser.id). Map each doc to notification card. onClick calls markNotificationRead(doc.id). Bell dot in header visible only when unread count > 0.

Wire 'usuarios' page: useEffect fetches getUsers(orgId). Map to rows: name, email, role label, 'Desconocido' (last access not stored), active status. Role-gate: hide 'Usuarios y roles' nav item if currentUser.role is not 'administrator'. Hide 'Parámetros' nav item if not administrator.
Add helper formatDate(isoString: string | undefined): returns formatted date or '—' if undefined/null. Defined once near top of component area, used by all wired pages.

Add roleLabelMap constant: { administrator: 'Administrador', senior_management: 'Alta dirección', environmental_manager: 'Resp. ambiental', auditor: 'Auditor', collaborator: 'Colaborador', supplier: 'Proveedor' }.
acceptance_criteria: Running `pnpm run generate:types 2>&1 | head -60` still completes without errors
Login form calls loginUser server action — bad credentials show inline error, good credentials navigate to shell
Register form calls registerUser and auto-logs in on success
On page reload, getCurrentUser() restores the session and skips the login screen
Dashboard shows counts sourced from real Payload queries (not static kpis array values)
Aspectos table shows real Aspect documents; 'Nuevo aspecto' button is hidden for collaborator/auditor roles
Creating a new aspect with all three factors calculates and stores significance+level in Payload
NonConformidades kanban shows real non-conformity documents grouped by status
Notifications page loads real notifications; clicking one marks it read
'Usuarios y roles' and 'Parámetros' nav items are hidden for non-administrator roles

findings: TypeScript check passes (tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck, exit 0). pnpm run generate:types fails with FIGMA_EID error (platform env var, known environment limitation from context.json). All FEAT-003 steps implemented: (1) AppContext created with AppUser type, organizationId derived from user.organization.id. (2) Login wired to loginUser/registerUser with inline error display; demo note div preserved. (3) EcoCertApp restores session on mount via getCurrentUser(); wraps shell in AppContext.Provider. (4) EcoCertShell reads currentUser from AppContext: dynamic greeting, real user name/role in sidebar footer, org name, role-gated nav items (usuarios/parametros hidden for non-admin). (5) Dashboard fetches getAspects/getObjectives/getNonConformities/getLegalRequirements/getNotifications in parallel; counts drive KPI cards with animate-pulse skeletons. (6) TablePage for all 7 table pages fetches live data via matching server actions; aspectos add button hidden for collaborator/auditor. (7) Modal extended per page: aspectos wires to createAspect with significance calc, legales to createLegalRequirement with user select, auditorias to createAudit with dynamic findings array, objetivos to createObjective with dynamic actions array and RN-05 validation, incidentes to createIncident, capacitacion to createTraining, evidencias to createEvidence with TODO note for file upload. (8) NonConformities kanban fetches getNonConformities and groups by status into 5 columns. (9) NotificationsPage fetches getNotifications; clicking marks read via markNotificationRead. (10) Bell badge only shown when unreadCount > 0. (11) formatDate helper and roleLabelMap constant added. File upload for evidences: TODO comment in UI; evidence record created without file as instructed.
